verdict.line: You lose if you stand in extended trades and let his shield snowball or get isolated by an unanswered Realm of Death; you win if you burst him fast off vitals and use Riposte to strip his engage.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even matchup (51.1% over 329 games) because the two champions win through opposite mechanics: Mordekaiser through poke damage converting into an Indestructible shield plus a hard-isolate ultimate, Fiora through true-damage vitals procs and positioning he can't contest since he has zero dash or blink. Whoever manages their cooldowns and W (Riposte) timing better decides the lane, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: after his E (Death's Grasp) lands, pulling you
theirWindow.what: Once the hand connects he can free-cast Q (Obliterate) and W (Siphon of Destruction) on a stationary target, and his shield grows off every point of damage he lands — disengage rather than trade through it, since staying in the fight only inflates the shield further.

yourWindow.when: his E (Death's Grasp) whiffs or is down
yourWindow.what: Death's Grasp is his only way to force you to stand still and it's on a long cooldown with no other gap-closer behind it. The moment it misses, dash in with Q (Lunge), pop E (Bladework), and commit — he has no tool left to disengage or reposition.

powerCurve.note: Trade only after his Q (Obliterate) is spent
Circle to his flank, he can't chase

start.why: The 93.1%-picked start (52.1% over 388 games) gives the sustain and early AD needed to trade autos into Obliterate poke without losing the wave.

boots.why: Picked in 55.5% of games at 50.3% win rate — the magic resist directly blunts his Q/W poke damage and the pull from E (Death's Grasp) still lands, but the follow-up hurts far less.

core.why: Highest-pickrate first item (part of the 56.6% winrate, 31.7% pick path) — the cleave and lifesteal let you win short, bursty trades before his shield can build.
The empowered auto after E (Bladework) with Trinity's proc is what actually spikes your duel window against his growing HP pool.
Converts his burst poke (Q into W) into damage-over-time you can outheal, which is exactly what keeps you alive through his highest-damage combo.

situational.when: if he's ahead and threatening to burst you down with a full combo before you can vitals-proc him
if you're already ahead and want a faster all-in spike instead of the sustain-focused path
if the lane is a slow poke war and you need the extra sustain/damage before committing to fights

runes.keystoneWhy: The 59.3% winrate page outperforms the Press the Attack page here, and Conqueror's healing directly offsets his poke while ramping toward the true-damage burst window you're building around.

summoners.why: The dominant pick (92.2% of games, 51.8% win rate) — Ignite gives you the extra burst to close out an all-in once his E (Death's Grasp) whiffs, since he has no mobility to escape it.

playing.title: Bait Obliterate before engaging
playing.detail: His Q (Obliterate) is his only burst tool early and has a real cooldown — once he throws it as poke, walk in immediately since he has nothing else to punish the approach.

playing.title: Save W for E or R, per the matchup read
playing.detail: Riposte can block either his E (Death's Grasp) pull or his R (Realm of Death) cast — blocking E denies his only way to force a stand-still fight, and a well-timed block on R can prevent the isolation duel entirely.

playing.title: Circle for side and back vitals
playing.detail: He has no dash or blink, so rotating to his flank between trades gets you easier vitals procs (bonus true damage plus self-heal) that he physically cannot reposition to stop.

playing.title: Keep trades short, not sustained
playing.detail: Indestructible shields off a percentage of damage he deals, so a long fight only inflates his shield — burst with Q into an empowered E auto, then reset instead of standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: Time all-ins off a whiffed Death's Grasp
playing.detail: E has a long cooldown and nothing backs it up — a missed hook is your green light to Lunge in and fully commit.

playing.title: Respect the level-6 isolate threat
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, don't overextend near brush or river where he can land Realm of Death mid-trade; if you get pulled into it without W available, play to disengage rather than stand and fight, since no ally can help you inside it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and every win-rate/pick-rate figure above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade timing, vitals positioning, and W-usage reasoning are my own tactical read, not part of the measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to block either Mordekaiser’s (E) or his (R). Do not let him maintain his (P) by keeping your distance while fighting him.
